The bank maintains a dominant competitive position as the #1 U.S. bank by market cap, #1 in global investment banking fees, and #1 in retail deposit share. Its diversified business model across Consumer & Community Banking, Corporate & Investment Bank, Commercial Banking, and Asset & Wealth Management provides resilience across economic cycles.
